ruleDefinitions.name: New User Created Via Net.EXE With Never Expire Option
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects creation of local users via the net.exe command with the option "never expire"

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\net\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\net1\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "net\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "net1\.exe")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*user.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*add.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*expires\\:never.*")))
